claim: De Jonkman sits at Maalsesteenweg 438 with chef Filip Claeys' sustainability-led seafood kitchen and a bus stop at Sint-Kruis Vijversdreef.
quote: De Jonkman is situated at Maalse Steenweg 438, 8310 Brugge, with convenient access via bus stop 502436 Sint-Kruis Vijversdreef and Station Brugge. Chef Filip Claeys leads the kitchen with a strong sustainability focus.

claim: De Jonkman holds two Michelin stars and serves Tuesday-Saturday lunch (noon-14:00) and dinner (19:00-21:00).
quote: De Jonkman – Sint-Kruis - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant. Operating hours (Tuesday-Saturday): Noon–2:00 PM and 7:00 PM–9:00 PM.

claim: Walking distances and times in this comparison are computed via the OSRM foot-routing profile on OpenStreetMap road data, at a 5 km/h pedestrian pace.
quote: Open Source Routing Machine — modern C++ routing engine for shortest paths in road networks.

claim: B&B Domo Togan holds an aggregate 9.3 Booking.com rating.
quote: B&B Domo Togan – rated 9.3 by recent guests!

claim: Domo Togan is rated 4.8/5 on TripAdvisor (17 reviews), ranked #1 of 2 B&Bs in Sint-Kruis, with three rooms and hostess Veerle named for breakfast and local recommendations.
quote: Rating: 4.8 out of 5 bubbles (17 reviews). Ranking: #1 of 2 B&Bs in Sint-Kruis. Address: Maalse Steenweg 434, Sint-Kruis 8310, Belgium. 3 rooms available. Attentive owner (Veerle) who provides local recommendations and orientation.

claim: Domo Togan is a 3-star B&B at Maalsesteenweg 434 with free parking, garden, bicycle rental, and cash-only payment.
quote: B&B Domo Togan is a 3-star bed and breakfast situated in Maalsesteenweg 434 in Sint-Kruis district of Bruges... offers parking, a garden, private check-in/check-out, bicycle rental (additional charge), internet services... Payment for accommodation and services is accepted in cash only.

claim: Hof Ter Beuke at Beukenlaan 22 has five named suites (Habanero, Curcuma, Saffraan, Kalisse, Wasabi), extensive breakfast, and bills itself as a 'green oasis of quiet'.
quote: Beukenlaan 22, Brugge | +32 (0)498 50 97 00. Suite Habanero, Suite Curcuma, Suite Saffraan, Sweet Kalisse, Suite Wasabi. groene oase van stilte.

claim: Hof Ter Beuke is a 4-star B&B with 6 rooms featuring spa bath and sauna, balconies/terraces, from ~$207/night.
quote: Hof Ter Beuke is a 4-star Bed & Breakfast located in the Sint-Kruis district of Bruges... 6 rooms, some of them comprise a balcony and a terrace... Bathrooms feature a spa bathtub and a sauna... wellness facilities include a spa lounge. Rates start from $207.

claim: Hotel Lodewijk Van Male at Maalse Steenweg 488 is a 20-room country-style hotel with free parking, garden, pond, and 7-minute drive to Bruges centre.
quote: Hotel Lodewijk Van Male, located at Maalse Steenweg 488, Sint-Kruis 8310. 20 rooms... country-style hotel is surrounded by a large garden with a pond, and the center of Bruges is a 7-minute car ride away... There is a private car park.

claim: Lodewijk Van Male holds a 3.4/5 TripAdvisor average across 158 reviews, with renovated second-floor rooms praised and older rooms criticised for stained carpets, musty odors, and dated décor at €135+ rates.
quote: Rating: 3.4 of 5 bubbles (158 reviews). Renovated Rooms: Modern, clean, well-soundproofed spaces on the second floor receive strong praise. Older rooms feature stained carpets, creaky flooring, musty odors, and dated décor. €135+ nightly rates questioned given room quality issues.

claim: Guesthouse next Do at Schaakstraat 51 is a two-bedroom holiday home rated 9.6/10 across 116 reviews with 9.9 cleanliness and 9.9 facilities scores.
quote: Located at 51 Schaakstraat, Sint-Kruis, 8310 Bruges, Belgium... rated 9.6 out of 10 (exceptional) with 116 reviews... excellent scores for facilities (9.9), cleanliness (9.9), comfort (9.9), and value for money (9.6). Two bedrooms and two bathrooms.

claim: B&B La Corneille at Sint-Godelievedreef 32 is rated 9.3/10 across 339 reviews, run by Lawrence and Steve, cash-only, ~20 minutes' walk to Bruges centre.
quote: B&B La Corneille is located at Sint-Godelievedreef 32, Sint-Kruis, 8310 Bruges, Belgium. 9.3 'Superb' rating with 339 reviews... Hosts Lawrence and Steve are extremely pleasant... B&B La Corneille can only accept payment with cash. About a 20-minute walk into the town centre.

claim: Wellness Sweet Bonihu at Fortuinstraat 79 is a two-room B&B; The Loft has a private jacuzzi and infrared sauna in-room, Midsomer is ground-floor with terrace and welcomes dogs.
quote: Fortuinstraat 79, Sint Kruis Bruges, Belgium. 2 rooms: The Loft (second floor), Midsomer (ground floor). Private jacuzzi and infrared sauna in The Loft. Dogs welcome (Midsomer room). 20 minutes walking distance from Bruges city center.
